theorems.name: Step_pure_is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  intro hall h
  -- Each case names only the rule's variables; the premises it needs are taken by their type
  -- (`‹…›`), so the proof does not depend on the order in which the premises are generated.
  cases h with
  | unreachable => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | nop => exact iswf_Forall_nil _
  | drop => exact iswf_Forall_nil _
  | select_true =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨hval_1, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton hval_1
  | select_false =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, hval_2, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton hval_2
  | if_true c bt instr_1_lst instr_2_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_4 _ _ ‹wf_blocktype bt› ‹Forall _ instr_1_lst›)
  | if_false c bt instr_1_lst instr_2_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_4 _ _ ‹wf_blocktype bt› ‹Forall _ instr_2_lst›)
  | label_vals =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    assumption
  | br_zero v_n instr'_lst val'_lst val_lst admininstr_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    cases hall.1 with
    | admininstr_case_71 _ _ _ hinstrs hbody =>
      exact iswf_Forall_append
        (fun x hx => hbody x (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hx))))
        (iswf_Forall_map _ _ hinstrs (fun _ h => iswf_admininstr_instr h))
  | br_succ v_n instr'_lst val_lst l admininstr_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    cases hall.1 with
    | admininstr_case_71 _ _ _ _ hbody =>
      cases hbody (.BR (uN.mk_uN (proj_uN_0 l + 1)))
          (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self _))) with
      | admininstr_case_7 _ hl =>
        exact iswf_Forall_append (fun x hx => hbody x (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ hx)))
          (iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_7 _ (iswf_uN_of_succ hl)))
  | br_if_true c l =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_7 _ ‹wf_uN 32 l›)
  | br_if_false => exact iswf_Forall_nil _
  | br_table_lt i l_lst l' =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    have hl_lst : Forall (fun l => wf_uN 32 l) l_lst := ‹_›
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_7 _ (iswf_Forall_getElem!_of_lt hl_lst
      ‹proj_uN_0 (Option.get! (proj_num__0 i)) < l_lst.length›))
  | br_table_ge i l_lst l' =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_7 _ ‹wf_uN 32 l'›)
  | frame_vals =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    assumption
  | return_frame v_n f val'_lst val_lst admininstr_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    cases hall.1 with
    | admininstr_case_72 _ _ _ _ hbody =>
      exact fun x hx => hbody x (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hx)))
  | return_label v_n instr'_lst val_lst admininstr_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    cases hall.1 with
    | admininstr_case_71 _ _ _ _ hbody => exact fun x hx => hbody x (List.mem_append_left _ hx)
  | trap_vals => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | trap_label => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | trap_frame => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | unop_val nt c_1 unop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _
      (unop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_unop_ nt unop c_1 var_0› ‹wf_unop_ nt unop› ‹wf_num_ nt c_1›
        ‹var_0 ≠ none› rfl c (List.contains_iff_mem.mp ‹(Option.get! var_0).contains c›)))
  | unop_trap => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | binop_val nt c_1 c_2 binop c var_0 =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp ‹var_0 ≠ none›
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _
      (iswf_fun_binop_ ‹fun_binop_ nt binop c_1 c_2 (some l)› c
        (List.contains_iff_mem.mp ‹(Option.get! (some l)).contains c›)))
  | binop_trap => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | testop nt c_1 testop c var_0 =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ ‹wf_num_ numtype.I32 c›)
  | relop nt c_1 c_2 relop c var_0 =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ ‹wf_num_ numtype.I32 c›)
  | cvtop_val nt_1 c_1 nt_2 cvtop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _
      (cvtop___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_cvtop__ nt_1 nt_2 cvtop c_1 var_0› ‹wf_cvtop__ nt_1 nt_2 cvtop›
        ‹wf_num_ nt_1 c_1› ‹var_0 ≠ none› rfl c (List.contains_iff_mem.mp ‹(Option.get! var_0).contains c›)))
  | cvtop_trap => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | ref_is_null_true =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ (iswf_num_I32_of_lt (by decide)))
  | ref_is_null_false =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ (iswf_num_I32_of_lt (by decide)))
  | vvunop c_1 v_vvunop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vvunop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vvunop_ vectype.V128 v_vvunop c_1 var_0› (by decide)
        (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) ‹c = var_0›))
  | vvbinop c_1 c_2 v_vvbinop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vvbinop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vvbinop_ vectype.V128 v_vvbinop c_1 c_2 var_0› (by decide)
        (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h2) ‹c = var_0›))
  | vvternop c_1 c_2 c_3 v_vvternop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vvternop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vvternop_ vectype.V128 v_vvternop c_1 c_2 c_3 var_0› (by decide)
        (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h2) (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h3)
        ‹c = var_0›))
  | vvtestop c_1 c =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ ‹wf_num_ numtype.I32 c›)
  | vunop c_1 sh vunop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vunop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vunop_ sh vunop c_1 var_0› ‹wf_shape sh› ‹wf_vunop_ sh vunop›
        (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) ‹var_0 ≠ none› rfl c
        (List.contains_iff_mem.mp ‹(Option.get! var_0).contains c›)))
  | vunop_trap => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | vbinop_val c_1 c_2 sh vbinop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vbinop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vbinop_ sh vbinop c_1 c_2 var_0› ‹wf_shape sh› ‹wf_vbinop_ sh vbinop›
        (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h2) ‹var_0 ≠ none› rfl c
        (List.contains_iff_mem.mp ‹(Option.get! var_0).contains c›)))
  | vbinop_trap => exact iswf_Forall_singleton .admininstr_case_73
  | vtestop_true =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ (iswf_num_I32_of_lt (by decide)))
  | vtestop_false =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ (iswf_num_I32_of_lt (by decide)))
  | vrelop c_1 c_2 sh vrelop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vrelop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vrelop_ sh vrelop c_1 c_2 var_0› ‹wf_shape sh› ‹wf_vrelop_ sh vrelop›
        (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h2) ‹var_0 ≠ none›
        ‹Option.get! var_0 = c›.symm))
  | vshiftop c_1 v_n v_Jnn v_N vshiftop c c'_lst var_0_lst =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨-, -, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    have hsh : wf_shape (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn v_Jnn) (dim.mk_dim v_N)) := ‹_›
    have hlen : var_0_lst.length = c'_lst.length := ‹_›
    have hF : Forall₂ _ var_0_lst c'_lst := ‹_›
    have hne : Forall (fun e => e ≠ none) var_0_lst := ‹_›
    have hl : Forall (fun l => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype (shape.X (lanetype_Jnn v_Jnn) (dim.mk_dim v_N))) l)
        c'_lst := ‹_›
    refine iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST (inv_lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh ?_ ‹c = _›))
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨c', hc', hr⟩ := iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left hlen hF e he
    exact vshiftop__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ hr ‹wf_ishape _› ‹wf_vshiftop_ _ vshiftop› (hl c' hc')
      ‹wf_uN 32 (uN.mk_uN v_n)› (hne e he) rfl
  | vbitmask c v_Jnn v_N ci ci_1_lst var_1 var_0_lst =>
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _
      (iswf_num_I32 (irev__is_wf _ _ _ ‹wf_uN 32 ci› rfl)))
  | vswizzle c_1 c_2 v_Pnn v_M c ci_lst c'_lst k =>
    have hsh : wf_shape (shape.X (lanetype_packtype v_Pnn) (dim.mk_dim v_M)) := ‹_›
    have hl : Forall (fun k => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype (shape.X (lanetype_packtype v_Pnn) (dim.mk_dim v_M)))
        (lane_.mk_lane__0 (Jnn_packtype v_Pnn)
          (c'_lst[proj_uN_0 (Option.get! (proj_lane__0 ci_lst[k]!))]!))) (List.range v_M) := ‹_›
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (inv_lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh (iswf_Forall_map _ _ hl (fun _ h => h)) ‹c = _›))
  | vshuffle c_1 c_2 v_Pnn v_N i_lst c c'_lst k =>
    have hsh : wf_shape (shape.X (lanetype_packtype v_Pnn) (dim.mk_dim v_N)) := ‹_›
    have hl : Forall (fun k => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype (shape.X (lanetype_packtype v_Pnn) (dim.mk_dim v_N)))
        (lane_.mk_lane__0 (Jnn_packtype v_Pnn) (c'_lst[proj_uN_0 i_lst[k]!]!))) (List.range v_N) := ‹_›
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (inv_lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh (iswf_Forall_map _ _ hl (fun _ h => h)) ‹c = _›))
  | vsplat v_Lnn c_1 v_N c =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    have hsh : wf_shape (shape.X v_Lnn (dim.mk_dim v_N)) := ‹_›
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (inv_lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh (iswf_Forall_replicate _
        (packnum__is_wf _ _ _ ‹wf_num_ (unpack v_Lnn) c_1› ‹packnum_ v_Lnn c_1 ≠ none› rfl)) ‹c = _›))
  | vextract_lane_num c_1 nt v_N i c_2 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hall
    have hsh : wf_shape (shape.X (lanetype_numtype nt) (dim.mk_dim v_N)) := ‹_›
    have hlt : proj_uN_0 i < (lanes_ (shape.X (lanetype_numtype nt) (dim.mk_dim v_N)) c_1).length := ‹_›
    -- the two `‹_›` are the premises `unpacknum_ … ≠ none` and `c_2 = Option.get! (unpacknum_ …)`
    have hn := unpacknum__is_wf (lanetype_numtype nt) _ c_2
      (iswf_Forall_getElem!_of_lt (lanes__is_wf _ c_1 _ hsh (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) rfl) hlt) ‹_› ‹_›
    rw [iswf_unpack_lanetype_numtype] at hn
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (.admininstr_case_13 _ _ hn)
  | vextract_lane_pack c_1 pt v_N v_sx i c_2 =>

        (lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hsh (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) rfl)) ‹c = _›))
  | vextunop c_1 sh_2 sh_1 vextunop c var_0 =>
    simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall
    obtain ⟨h1, ⟨⟩, -⟩ := hall
    exact iswf_Forall_singleton (iswf_admininstr_VCONST
      (vextunop___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹fun_vextunop__ sh_1 sh_2 vextunop c_1 var_0› ‹wf_ishape sh_1›
        ‹wf_ishape sh_2› ‹wf_vextunop__ sh_1 sh_2 vextunop› (iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv h1) ‹var_0 ≠ none›
        ‹Option.get! var_0 = c›.symm))
  | vextbinop c_1 c_2 sh_2 sh_1 vextbinop c var_0 =>

theorems.notes:
Proved, no sorry/admit; compiles in about 1 s with no errors and no warnings. Statement is textually identical to the module's.

Cause of the 8 earlier errors: premises reordered or added. In unop_val, binop_val, cvtop_val, vunop and vbinop_val, 'var_0 ≠ none' and 'length > 0' swapped. vshiftop gained a new first length premise. In vbitmask, 'wf_uN 32 ci' moved from 6th to 7th. In vextract_lane_num, the bound and '≠ none' swapped.

Restructure: each case binds only the rule's variables. Step_pure premises are taken by type, either inline ‹T› or 'have h : T := ‹_›'. The proof therefore no longer depends on premise order. wf_admininstr facts about the instructions are still destructured with simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] plus obtain/cases. Terminal 'simp [hx]' membership proofs became explicit List.mem_append_left/right terms.

vshiftop gap closed from the restored first premise (List.length var_0_lst = List.length c'_lst) via iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left.

Helpers:
- No new helpers.
- Uses the 11 Step_pure helpers already directly above Step_pure_is_wf in the probe module (lines 14467-14508): iswf_Forall_singleton, iswf_Forall_cons_iff, iswf_Forall_replicate, iswf_admininstr_instr, iswf_uN_of_succ, iswf_num_I32_of_lt, iswf_unpack_lanetype_numtype, iswf_fun_binop_, iswf_admininstr_VCONST, iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv, iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left. All 11 are still used, so they must stay.
- Also uses earlier module lemmas: iswf_Forall_nil/append/cons/map, iswf_num_I32, iswf_Forall_getElem!_of_lt, iswf_Forall_modify.
- Uses no HelperPool29 lemma.

Placement checks: no module declaration at or after line 14525 is used. The module has no open/namespace/set_option, and no instances after line 14525, so the probe context matches the final placement.
